# Quench — Thermalization

Unformalized claims gathered verbatim from [wiphy.org](https://wiphy.org/) (query: “quantum quench holography”).

claims.name: using_holography_paper_studies_finitetemperature
claims.statement: Using holography, the paper studies finite-temperature quantum quenches of relevant operators with $2\leq\Delta\leq4$ by tracking the operator expectation value and stress tensor through the quench. It finds universal scaling behavior in both fast and slow quenches, with scaling exponents varying smoothly with $\Delta$, and shows that for fast quenches the relaxation time is fixed by the thermal timescale rather than by operator dimension or quench rate.
